title: Resilience Beyond Stationary Client Unavailability: Unlocking Efficient and Unbiased Federated Learning
summary: Due to resource constraints or external and internal uncertainties, clients in real-world federated learning systems are often intermittently available edge devices. In highly dynamic environments, the parameter server lacks prior real-time knowledge of clients' availability, making it challenging to adapt traditional federated learning algorithms to be resilient to uncertainties in client availability.
